item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Most people start the day already behind on water, and even mild dehydration dulls focus, mood, and patience. Those are the very things you're working to protect. Keep it simple: drink a full glass soon after waking, then sip steadily instead of chugging late. Your day has plenty of natural pauses. Use them. Action: fill a water bottle right now and set it where you'll see it.
